ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from selecting a Site Visit Time before 8:00 AM or after 10:00 PM. Only times between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM, inclusive, are allowed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Site_Visit_Time__c)), OR( Site_Visit_Time__c < TIMEVALUE("08:00:00.000"), Site_Visit_Time__c > TIMEVALUE("22:00:00.000") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Site Visit Time must be between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM.
